summary: Backfill four pull requests that merged after v0.3.17 without a fragment: an agent-policy document (#1585), two cost-probe test changes (#1519, #1514) and a hidden machine-readable command-inventory flag on st3 (#1520).

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection migration. The four merges change AGENTS.md, test files, one test module inside crates/st3/src/peer.rs, and the argument handling at the start of crates/st3/src/main.rs; none reads or writes claims or projections.

schema.detail: No database schema, index or persisted-format change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: #1520 adds a hidden global flag, --read-contract-inventory-json. When it is the only argument, st3 prints a JSON inventory of its commands and aliases and exits before any other startup work. With any other argument it exits 2 naming the misuse; after a literal -- it is passed through unchanged. The flag does not appear in help, and no existing command, option, protocol or harness behavior changes. #1585, #1519 and #1514 change no runtime behavior: #1585 edits AGENTS.md, #1519 and #1514 change only test code.

downtime.detail: No service restart or interruption is needed for these changes.

recovery.detail: Revert the affected merge to remove the flag or the document text; no durable state is written.
